tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active, worldwide-remote, non-partner job listings. Returns up to 20 summarized rows (no full description). Jobs that are region-locked away from Indonesia are excluded by default; every row carries `indonesiaEligibility` (id_friendly | restricted | unknown) plus the raw `geoFit`/`applicantRegion` it was derived from.

include_region_locked.description: Default false. When true, also return jobs restricted to a region an Indonesia-based applicant cannot work from (geo_fit = restricted, or applicant_region in US/UK/EU/Canada/North America). Check each row's `indonesiaEligibility` before recommending one.

remote_usd_only.description: Only worldwide-remote jobs paid in USD.

freshness.description: fresh | active | stale_risk (W5 tier; omit for no filter).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single active job's summary by id (no full description). Region-locked jobs are withheld by default, same as search_jobs.

job_id.description: Job id from a search_jobs result.

include_region_locked.description: Default false. When true, return the job even if it is region-locked away from Indonesia; read `indonesiaEligibility` on the result.

tools.name: get_curated_list
tools.description: The hand-vetted AI-data-work platform list (Outlier, Mercor, micro1, Mindrift, DataAnnotation.tech, Appen, Remotasks) — the /kerja-ai landing page's inventory.

tools.name: get_salary_benchmark
tools.description: Monthly IDR salary benchmark (median, p25, p75, sample size) per role x seniority cell over the last 90 days; cells under the minimum sample are suppressed. Without a key or with a free key you get the free layer (largest-sample cells only); a key with paid market access gets every cell. Same data as GET /api/v1/market/salary. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).

tools.name: get_skill_demand
tools.description: Top in-demand skills across active remote listings, by mention count. Without a key or with a free key you get the free layer (top rows only); a key with paid market access gets more rows. Same data as GET /api/v1/market/skills. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).

tools.name: get_hiring_trend
tools.description: Current hiring snapshot for one role family: active-listing volume, seniority and remote mix, top skills and top hiring companies (point in time, not a time series). Omit `role` to list the role families. Without a key or with a free key you get the free layer (ranked tables trimmed); a key with paid market access gets every row. Same data as GET /api/v1/market/roles/{role}. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).

role.description: Role family slug, e.g. engineering, data-ai, design. Omit to list all families.

tools.name: request_commercial_access
tools.description: For a company that wants to use Loker Dollar job, talent or market data commercially or in bulk (beyond the free per-IP limits). Sends the request to a person at Loker Dollar, who replies to the work email within one business day. Requires a work email on the company domain (personal webmail is rejected). Only call this when the user asks for it and supplied these details. Self-serve paid access per call is on Apify (see paid_access.url).

work_email.description: Work email on the company domain; the reply goes here.

use_case.description: What the company wants to build or do with the data (max 1000 chars).

volume.description: Optional expected volume, e.g. '50k job rows/month' or '200 talent searches/month'.
